newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to lend Uzbekistan 9.7 bln yen for oil unit.
newsitem.headline: Japan to lend Uzbekistan 9.7 bln yen for oil unit.

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of Japan said on Tuesday it and two Japanese banks would extend a loan of 9.7 billion yen to Uzbekistan.
The loan will be used to buy a desulphurisation unit from Japan's Mitsui & Co Ltd for the state-owned Fergana refinery, the Export-Import Bank said in a statement.
The Export-Import Bank will provide 60 percent of the loan, while the remaining 40 percent will be shouldered by Sakura Bank Ltd and the Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd .
The desulphurisation unit, with an annual capacity of 1.7 million tonnes, will enable Uzbekistan to produce diesel fuel with low-sulphur content using domestically produced crude.
Uzbekistan is trying to reduce its dependency on Russia for imports of crude and oil products and cut back foreign currency expenditures, the statement said.
Uzbekistan crude has a higher sulphur content than Russian crude, therefore desulphurising facilities are needed to produce quality diesel fuel, it added.
